get.description: Return a list of all Sub Jobs in a specified Project.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

origin_id.description: Third-party unique identifier assigned by an ERP or external integration system. Null when the sub job has not been synced with an external system. Use to correlate sub jobs with records in an integrated ERP.

origin_code.description: Third-party code assigned by an ERP or external integration system, distinct from origin_id. Null when the sub job has not been synced externally or when the integration does not use a separate code field.

origin_data.description: Arbitrary JSON string containing additional third-party data associated with this sub job by an external integration. Null when not synced externally. Parse as JSON to access individual fields.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this sub job was created. Use to sort or filter sub jobs by creation date.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this sub job was last modified. Use to detect whether cached sub job data needs to be refreshed.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this sub job. Use as the {id} path parameter in GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/sub_jobs/{id}.

name.description: Display name of the sub job shown in the UI and budget code pickers (e.g. "Floor 2", "Phase 1 - Foundation").

code.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the sub job within the project. Unique per project (scoped to project_id). Null when no code has been assigned. Use as a compact identifier in budget code strings.

403.description: User does not have right permissions.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
